name: Continue

name: LangChain
description: LangChain is an open-source framework for developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs). It provides tools and abstractions to connect LLMs with external data sources, enabling context-aware applications like chatbots and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) .
bestFor: Building applications that require integrating LLMs with external data and APIs
Creating chatbots with memory and context management
Developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
Building agents that can perform multi-step actions and use tools
strengths: Modular framework with components for chains, agents, retrieval, and memory
Supports integration with numerous LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) and vector stores
Offers LangChain Expression Language (LCEL) for composing chains with built-in streaming and retries
Provides a simplified agent creation interface (`create_agent`)
gettingStarted: Install the core LangChain package and packages for your chosen LLM provider: `pip install langchain langchain-openai`
Set up environment variables for your API keys: `export OPENAI_API_KEY='your_key'`
Import modules and create a simple chain using LCEL: `from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI; from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate`
Run the chain with `chain.invoke({"input": "your question"})`
usageNotes: Key building blocks are Prompts, Output Parsers, RAG (retrieval and vector stores), and Agents
LangChain agents use an LLM as a reasoning engine to determine actions and tool use
The framework supports memory components to maintain conversation state across interactions
For production, consider using LangGraph for complex, stateful agents, and LangSmith for tracing and debugging
priceDetails: LangChain is an open-source framework available for free .

name: Deep Agents
description: A harness for building agents that can plan, delegate to sub-agents, and use a virtual filesystem for complex, multi-step tasks. It is built on LangGraph and inspired by systems like Claude Code .

Tasks that involve delegating work to specialized sub-agents

usageNotes: The agent uses a structured system prompt with rules, examples, and anti-derailment instructions .
Skills are defined in `SKILL.md` files and loaded on demand based on task requirements .
The harness includes a virtual filesystem with tools like `ls`, `read_file`, and `write_file` for persistent memory .
Memory can be managed using `AGENTS.md` files that are loaded at startup .

start: from agent_framework import Agent; agent = Agent(...); await agent.run('...')

name: Agent Development Kit
description: An open-source, code-first toolkit from Google for building, evaluating, and deploying complex AI agents and multi-agent systems .
bestFor: developers building complex multi-agent systems
teams needing fine-grained control over agent logic and orchestration
production deployment with integration into Google Cloud services
strengths: code-first design for flexibility and version control
supports building hierarchical, multi-agent systems with clear delegation
offers multiple interaction interfaces: CLI, Web UI, and API
provides integrated evaluation tools for testing agent performance
designed for production deployment anywhere, with managed options via Vertex AI Agent Engine
available in Python, Go, and Java
gettingStarted: Install the ADK package for your preferred language (e.g., `pip install google-adk` for Python) .
Define your agent's logic and tools in code, using the `LlmAgent` class .
Run your agent locally for testing using the `adk web` or `adk run` commands .
usageNotes: Agents are defined in Python using the `google.adk` library .
The framework uses a Runner component to manage the execution loop, handle session state, and pass messages between the user, agent, and tools .
Multi-agent systems can be built using hierarchical structures where a root agent delegates tasks to specialized sub-agents based on their `description` .
Session state and memory can be managed using various services like `InMemorySessionService` for development or `FirestoreSessionService` for production .
Agents can be deployed to various environments, including Cloud Run, GKE, and Vertex AI Agent Engine .
